exactMissSummary.warning: Actual queried row IDs, never summed ledger counts; a current eligible label is not independent PH adjudication or a first-publication receipt

limitations: Sequential reads and GET are not an atomic snapshot
Only17 retained exact miss URLs and seven named sources are traced; location variants are not distinct openings
Current-admission view membership is weaker than the full immutable packet validator and grants no authority
Event/ledger limits can truncate; ledger counts and empty ID arrays are not actual publication receipts
Posted/scraped timestamps and current labels do not certify first publication, PH precision or daily verified throughput
The unchanged public predicate is active+eligible_verified/eligible_likely; no lifetime serving-age rule is added
Snapshot headers describe serving response, not provider or GCP runtime health; cached HTML can replay render-time metadata
Ordinary public GET may trigger the application's normal snapshot refresh; observer sends no mutation request
No provider fetch, manual scraper, real AI, deployment, source/config change or direct production write; control-plane comparison is left to the parent task
